text: ＊の　ジムは　きょうてき　ばかりだ……　たたかう　じゅんびにでた！

structure.jp: きょうてき　ばかりだ……
たたかう　じゅんびにでた！
structure.en: went out to prepare to fight

patterns.name: 〜ばかり
patterns.span: きょうてき　ばかりだ
patterns.explanation: ばかり means 'nothing but'. きょうてき　ばかりだ = 'it's all tough opponents'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: たたかう　じゅんび
patterns.explanation: A plain verb before a noun describes it. たたかう　じゅんび = 'preparation to fight'.
